en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a small Alpine town nestled in a broad valley surrounded by mountains. In the foreground stands a large church with a patterned tile roof and a tall Gothic-style bell tower, dominating the clustered roofs of the town. Beyond the town are open fields stretching toward distant mountains. At the bottom left, stylized white text reads "Predazzo  Panorama," identifying the place and the type of view.
